explanation: Faithful to 'Can it be bounded (when it exists) in terms of the order of the basis?'. There is f : ℕ → ℕ such that every A with HasOrder A h and some restricted order has restricted order ≤ f h. Since HasOrder means order ≤ h, this is equivalent via running maxima, as the docstring notes. HasOrder uses at most h summands, so 0 ∈ A is irrelevant.
